activity.notes: Moshoeshoe I united the Basotho political community and founded the polity that became Lesotho. ATLAS uses the historical Basotho Kingdom rather than back-projecting the later independent-state name Lesotho across the whole nineteenth-century reign.

sources.title: About Lesotho
sources.citation_text: The Government of Lesotho states that Moshoeshoe I united the land under one rule in 1822.

sources.title: Basotho Remember King Moshoeshoe I
sources.citation_text: The Government of Lesotho records Moshoeshoe's leadership from 1822 and his death in 1870.
